description: Manage the Human Resource function for e-Cycle's corporate office as well as their fulfillment and data center, consisting of benefits and compensation administration, payroll, employee relations, policy compliance, and recruitment.

As a leader within the HR and Operations team, I was instrumental in partnering with local leadership and Corporate HR to develop and implement HR policies, processes, technology and services that are aligned to support our company's strategic initiatives.
As a member of the executive team, I was directly and solely responsible for providing situation appropriate and policy compliant human resource support for 2 separate business units.
Fulfilled a broad range of HR Generalist functions, including recruiting, administering benefits, overseeing disciplinary action and managing HR support staff.

certifications.name: Muskingum Valley Human Resource Management Association

matchmaking_summary: The candidate has an impressive track record in managing human resources, particularly in the sectors of benefits administration and employee relations across multiple companies. With a strong background in HR practices and strategic partnering to support organizational initiatives, they demonstrate excellent leadership skills and commitment to legal compliance while fostering positive workplace cultures.
